paragraphs: Vaughn Law is proud to say that we have the experience and know-how to exceed your expectations. We meet or surpass the compliance guidelines that are required of lenders.

We are experienced in closing residential, commercial, and construction loans! Vaughn Law is fully TRID compliant. We have been vetted and approved by Secure Insight. Furthermore, we protect your interest against any title defects by carefully reviewing your instructions to ensure that all documents are executed properly and in a timely fashion. If an issue does arise after closing, we are quick to respond and resolve the issue.
As a lender, working with Vaughn Law means:

items.text: Advanced technology to ensure ease of the transaction
Ability to assist with correcting title issues and preparing legal documents necessary for closing

body.text: Vaughn Law is a member of The Fund and underwrites with Old Republic.
